description: This Java source file defines a factory class for creating SASL authenticators used in an AMQP adapter to handle client device authentication via various mechanisms like PLAIN and EXTERNAL. It contains implementation details for initiating, processing, and verifying SASL authentication, managing connection limits, and performing certificate validation.

classes.name: AmqpAdapterSaslAuthenticatorFactory
classes.description: A factory class to create SASL authenticators for the AMQP adapter, supporting mechanisms like PLAIN and EXTERNAL and handling connection limits and certificate validation.

classes.name: AmqpAdapterSaslAuthenticator
classes.description: An inner class managing the SASL authentication process for individual connections, including mechanism selection, response parsing, credential verification, and integrating with tracing and connection limits.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the inner class AmqpAdapterSaslAuthenticator to handle SASL authentication.

methods.name: getSupportedMechanisms
methods.description: Determines supported SASL mechanisms based on available authentication providers.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the SASL authenticator with socket, connection, and transport details, and configures the mechanisms and SSL session.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes an authentication attempt, handling mechanism selection, parsing responses, and verifying credentials.

methods.name: buildSaslResponseContext
methods.description: Constructs the response context based on the provided mechanism and SASL response.

methods.name: parseSaslResponse
methods.description: Parses the raw SASL response bytes into fields.

methods.name: invokePreAuthenticationHandler
methods.description: Calls an optional pre-authentication handler after receiving the SASL response.

methods.name: succeeded
methods.description: Indicates if the SASL authentication succeeded.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Verifies the SASL credentials based on the mechanism used (PLAIN or EXTERNAL).

methods.name: verifyPlain
methods.description: Performs verification of PLAIN mechanism credentials against tenant and device information.

methods.name: verifyExternal
methods.description: Performs verification of EXTERNAL mechanism credentials via certificate validation.

methods.name: getTenantObject
methods.description: Retrieves tenant information based on issuer DN or tenant ID.

methods.name: checkTenantIsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the AMQP adapter is enabled for the specified tenant.
